name: Naive Tetrahedral Surfacing
definition: A surface extraction method that iterates through all pairs of sample points within a tetrahedron to find intersections with an isosurface, rather than using the standard 14 case lookup table based on vertex signs. It assumes the tetrahedron has vertices sorted or processed such that 'less than iso' and 'more than iso' lists are maintained.
summary: Naive Tetrahedral Surfacing is an isosurface extraction method that processes each tetrahedron independently to generate unconnected polygons by iterating through all pairs of sample points to find intersections, rather than using the standard 14-case lookup table.
